')!important}
.bfpeer-tweet-footer{display:flex;gap:24px;padding:8px 12px;border-top:2px solid #c1d9e8}
.bfpeer-bottom-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,.9fr) minmax(0,1.1fr);gap:13px;align-items:stretch}
.bfpeer-reactions,.bfpeer-decide,.bfpeer-reveal{background:#0e356e;border:2px solid #28c6f4;padding:12px;display:grid;gap:9px;min-width:0}
.bfpeer-section-top{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px}
.bfpeer-reactions h2,.bfpeer-decide h2,.bfpeer-reveal h2{font:900 clamp(14px,1.2vw,19px) var(--bf-font-display);color:var(--bf-yellow);margin:0}
.bfpeer-simulation-tag{border:1px solid #86dbfb;color:#cdf4ff;padding:4px 6px;font:750 10px var(--bf-font-display)}
.bfpeer-sim-caption{font:750 clamp(11px,.88vw,13px)/1.4 var(--bf-font-body);color:#f1f9ff;margin:0}
.bfpeer-reaction-list{display:grid;gap:7px}
.bfpeer-reaction{display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto 1fr auto;align-items:center;gap:8px;background:#113a78;border:1px solid #318cc0;padding:8px 10px;color:#f4f8ff;font:750 clamp(12px,.94vw,14px) var(--bf-font-body)}
.bfpeer-reaction-icon{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
.bfpeer-reaction strong{font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;color:#fff}
.bfpeer-note{color:#bfe9fa;font:700 clamp(10px,.82vw,12px)/1.45 var(--bf-font-body)}
.bfpeer-options{display:grid;gap:8px}
.bfpeer-post{background:#103c7d;color:#f8fbff;border:2px solid var(--bf-cyan);min-height:46px;padding:10px 12px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;text-align:left;font:750 clamp(12px,1vw,15px)/1.38 var(--bf-font-body);box-shadow:3px 3px #01102e;cursor:pointer;border-radius:0}
.bfpeer-post:hover,.bfpeer-post:focus-visible{background:#18558a;border-color:var(--bf-yellow)}
.bfpeer-reveal{gap:12px}
.bfpeer-reveal-comparison{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:12px}
.bfpeer-evidence{min-width:0;display:grid;gap:8px;align-content:start;background:#113b79;border:2px solid #28bcec;padding:10px}
.bfpeer-evidence>span{font:900 12px/1.3 var(--bf-font-display);color:var(--bf-yellow)}
.bfpeer-evidence-thumb{width:100%;aspect-ratio:16/9;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-position:center;background-size:contain;background-color:#0d2b5c;image-rendering:pixelated}
.bfpeer-evidence p{font:700 clamp(12px,.96vw,15px)/1.43 var(--bf-font-body);margin:0;color:#fff}
.bfpeer-lesson{font:700 clamp(12px,1vw,15px)/1.4 var(--bf-font-body);background:#102f65;border-left:4px solid var(--bf-yellow);padding:12px;color:#fff;margin:0}
.bfpeer-lesson strong{color:var(--bf-yellow)}
.bfpeer-actions{display:flex;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.bfpeer-actions button{font-size:13px!important;min-height:45px;padding:10px 14px!important}
.bfpeer-skip{color:#e0f6ff;border:2px solid #359ac7;background:#0e3169;padding:9px 12px;align-self:start;cursor:pointer;font:750 12px var(--bf-font-body)}
@media(max-width:950px){.bfpeer .bfmvp-receiver-layout{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) 225px!important}.bfpeer-bottom-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}}
@media(max-width:780px){.bfpeer .bfmvp-receiver-layout{display:flex!important;flex-direction:column!important}.bfpeer .bfmvp-receiver-play,.bfpeer .bfmvp-guide{width:100%!important;overflow:visible!important;min-height:0!important}.bfpeer-stage{padding:13px}.bfpeer-bottom-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.bfpeer .bfmvp-guide{order:2!important}.bfpeer-scene{min-height:0;max-height:none}}
@media(max-width:500px){.bfpeer-reveal-comparison{grid-template-columns:1fr}.bfpeer-intro h1{font-size:clamp(20px,6vw,26px)}.bfpeer .bfpeer-tweet>p{font-size:14px}.bfpeer-options{gap:7px}}
/* Retratos humanos pixel art para el Guía, sin personajes cuadrados. */
.bfpeer .bfmvp-guide-avatar{background-image:url('data:image/png;base64,')!important;background-size:cover!important;background-position:center top!important;background-repeat:no-repeat!important;background-color:#184783!important;border-color:var(--bf-cyan)!important}
.bfpeer .bfmvp-guide-avatar.bfmvp-avatar-red{background-image:url('data:image/png;base64,')!important;border-color:var(--bf-pink)!important}
.bfpeer .bfmvp-guide-avatar .bfmvp-pixel-head{display:none!important}

/* V42: revelación compacta. Una publicación y dos evidencias alineadas en 50/25/25. */
.bfpeer-is-reveal .bfpeer-stage{gap:10px;padding:clamp(12px,1.35vw,18px)}
.bfpeer-is-reveal .bfpeer-intro{gap:3px}
.bfpeer-is-reveal .bfpeer-intro h1{font-size:clamp(19px,1.85vw,26px)}
.bfpeer-is-reveal .bfpeer-intro p{font-size:clamp(12px,1vw,14px)}
.bfpeer-is-reveal .bfpeer-reveal{display:grid;gap:10px;padding:10px 12px}
.bfpeer-is-reveal .bfpeer-reveal h2{font-size:clamp(14px,1.15vw,18px)}
.bfpeer-reveal-layout{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,2fr) minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,1fr);gap:10px;align-items:start;min-width:0}
.bfpeer-reveal-layout>*{min-width:0}
.bfpeer-primary .bfpeer-tweet{width:100%;min-width:0;box-shadow:none}
.bfpeer-is-reveal .bfpeer-tweet>p{font-size:clamp(12px,1vw,15px);padding:8px 10px;line-height:1.3}
.bfpeer-is-reveal .bfpeer-post-heading{font-size:clamp(10px,.81vw,12px);padding:7px 9px}
.bfpeer-is-reveal .bfpeer-scene{height:clamp(135px,17vw,222px);max-height:222px;aspect-ratio:auto;background-size:contain!important;background-color:#14396c!important}
.bfpeer-is-reveal .bfpeer-tweet-footer{padding:5px 9px;gap:14px}
.bfpeer-reveal-layout .bfpeer-evidence{padding:8px;gap:6px;min-height:0;align-content:start}
.bfpeer-reveal-layout .bfpeer-evidence>span{font-size:clamp(10px,.82vw,12px)}
.bfpeer-reveal-layout .bfpeer-evidence-thumb{width:100%;height:clamp(95px,9.8vw,145px);aspect-ratio:auto;background-size:contain;background-position:center;background-color:#123665}
.bfpeer-reveal-layout .bfpeer-evidence p{font-size:clamp(11px,.86vw,13px);line-height:1.32;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.bfpeer-is-reveal .bfpeer-lesson{font-size:clamp(12px,.95vw,14px);padding:9px 11px}
.bfpeer-is-reveal .bfpeer-actions{gap:9px}
.bfpeer-is-reveal .bfpeer-actions button{min-height:40px;padding:7px 11px!important;font-size:12px!important}
/* El Guía permanece visible, sin forzar columnas estrechas o desplazamiento horizontal. */
@media(max-width:1090px) and (min-width:781px){
  .bfpeer-is-reveal .bfmvp-receiver-layout{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) 205px!important;gap:8px!important}
  .bfpeer-is-reveal .bfpeer-reveal-layout{gap:7px}
  .bfpeer-is-reveal .bfpeer-reveal-layout .bfpeer-evidence{padding:6px}
}
@media(max-width:780px){
  .bfpeer-is-reveal .bfpeer-reveal-layout{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,2fr) minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,1fr)}
  .bfpeer-is-reveal .bfpeer-scene{height:clamp(130px,25vw,200px)}
  .bfpeer-is-reveal .bfpeer-reveal-layout .bfpeer-evidence-thumb{height:clamp(90px,15vw,120px)}
}
@media(max-width:620px){
  .bfpeer-is-reveal .bfpeer-reveal-layout{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,1fr)}
  .bfpeer-is-reveal .bfpeer-primary{grid-column:1/-1}
  .bfpeer-is-reveal .bfpeer-scene{height:auto;aspect-ratio:16/9;max-height:215px}
  .bfpeer-is-reveal .bfpeer-reveal-layout .bfpeer-evidence-thumb{height:clamp(85px,25vw,125px)}
  .bfpeer-is-reveal .bfpeer-reveal-layout .bfpeer-evidence p{font-size:12px}
}


/* V32 · accessibility.css */
button:not(:disabled):active{transform:translate(2px,2px)!important;box-shadow:1px 1px 0 #021332!important}
button:disabled{cursor:default!important}
.bfpx-screenreader{position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;padding:0;margin:-1px;overflow:hidden;clip:rect(0 0 0 0);white-space:nowrap;border:0}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*{transition:none!important;animation-duration:.01ms!important;animation-iteration-count:1!important;scroll-behavior:auto!important}}


/* V32 · responsive.css */
@media(max-width:1120px){
 .bfmvp-mission-stage{grid-template-columns:1fr!important}
 .bfmvp-tweet-body{display:grid!important;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,1.05fr)!important;align-items:stretch}
 .bfmvp-tweet .bfmvp-art{aspect-ratio:auto!important;min-height:220px!important;border-left:2px solid #1f92c0!important;border-top:0!important}
 .bfmvp-choice-group{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr!important}
 .bfmvp-receiver-layout{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.52fr) minmax(245px,.82fr)!important}
}
@media(max-width:850px){
 .bf24-layout,.bfmvp-receiver-layout{gap:10px!important;padding:10px!important}
 .bf24-layout{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.6fr) minmax(240px,.95fr)!important}
 .bf24-news-label,.bfmvp-receiver-header>strong{padding:9px 10px!important}
 .bf24-headlines,.bfmvp-receiver-ticker{font-size:10px!important}
 .bf25-headlines-screen .bf25-grid{gap:9px!important}
 .bf24-option,.bf24-option.b{min-height:170px!important}
}
@media(max-width:780px){
 .bfmvp-receiver{height:auto!important;min-height:100dvh!important;overflow:visible!important}
 .bfmvp-receiver-layout,.bf24-layout{display:flex!important;flex-direction:column!important}
 .bfmvp-receiver-play,.bfmvp-guide,.bf24-main,.bf24-guide{width:100%;overflow:visible!important;min-height:auto!important}
 .bfmvp-guide,.bf24-guide{min-height:160px!important}
 .bfmvp-receiver-header,.bf24-news{min-height:60px!important;height:60px!important}
 .bfmvp-receiver-ticker{display:none!important}
 .bf24-headlines{display:none!important}
 .bfmvp-mission-stage{grid-template-columns:1fr!important}
 .bfmvp-tweet-body{grid-template-columns:1fr!important}
 .bfmvp-tweet .bfmvp-art{aspect-ratio:1.7/1!important;min-height:0!important;border-left:0!important;border-top:2px solid #1f92c0!important}
 .bfmvp-choice-group{grid-template-columns:1fr!important}
 .bf25-headlines-screen .bf25-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr!important}
 .bfmvp-end-banner,.bfmvp-end-main,.bfmvp-switch-scene{grid-template-columns:1fr!important}
 .bfmvp-end-banner .bfmvp-art,.bfmvp-switch-art{max-width:210px!important}
 .bf24-option,.bf24-option.b{min-height:140px!important}
 .bf24-rumor-screen{padding:18px!important}
 .bf24-options{grid-template-columns:1fr!important}
 .bfmvp-mission-top h1{font-size:clamp(20px,5vw,28px)!important}
 .bfmvp-end{padding:16px!important}
}
@media(max-width:400px){
 .bf24-news,.bfmvp-receiver-header{padding:6px 10px!important}
 .bf24-news-label,.bfmvp-receiver-header>strong{font-size:11px!important;padding:8px!important}
 .bfmvp-mission{padding:13px!important}
 .bfmvp-guide-inner{padding:13px!important}
 .bfmvp-mission-top h1{font-size:22px!important}
 .bfmvp-tweet-copy{font-size:14px!important}
 .bfmvp-timer{grid-template-columns:1fr auto!important}.bfmvp-timer button{grid-column:1/-1!important}
 .bfmvp-story-result{padding:16px!important}
}


/* V32 · intro-v34.css */
/* V34 — portada y primeras pantallas. Regla: mismo universo pixel art y mismos controles. */
.bf34-menu{background:#071733!important;background-image:repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, #071733 0 14px, #0b2146 14px 18px)!important}
.bf34-menu-stage{outline:3px solid #29ccf8!important;outline-offset:-3px;box-shadow:0 0 0 5px #010d2c!important;background-size:100% 100%!important;image-rendering:pixelated!important}
.bf34-menu .menu-hotspot{border-radius:0!important}
.bf34-menu .menu-hotspot::before,.bf34-menu .menu-hotspot::after{border-radius:0!important;animation:none!important;filter:none!important;transition:none!important;box-shadow:none!important}
.bf34-menu .menu-hotspot:hover,.bf34-menu .menu-hotspot:focus-visible{outline:4px dashed #ffe784!important;outline-offset:2px!important;background:rgba(255,220,94,.12)!important}
.bf34-resume{position:absolute;top:4.5%;right:3.2%;z-index:4;background:#0a3e79;color:#fff;border:3px solid #56d5f8;border-radius:0;box-shadow:4px 4px #031235;font-family:var(--bf-font-display);font-weight:900;font-size:clamp(10px,.95vw,15px);padding:12px;letter-spacing:.02em;cursor:pointer}
.bf34-resume:hover,.bf34-resume:focus-visible{background:#14639b;color:#ffe382}
/* Color y atmósfera de Friends desde la aceptación, no paneles blancos modales. */
.bf34-onboarding{backdrop-filter:none!important;background:#04132de8!important;image-rendering:pixelated}
.bf34-onboarding .bf34-consent{width:min(725px,100%)!important;max-height:min(94dvh,760px)!important;background:#0c2a62!important;border:4px solid #22caff!important;box-shadow:7px 7px #020b23!important;padding:clamp(14px,2vw,29px)!important;text-align:left!important}
.bf34-scene-flag{font-family:var(--bf-font-display);font-weight:900;color:#ffdc60;font-size:clamp(11px,1.1vw,15px);text-align:center;letter-spacing:.05em;margin-bottom:12px}
.bf34-consent h2{font-family:var(--bf-font-display)!important;font-size:clamp(23px,2.65vw,33px)!important;color:#ffe275!important;text-align:center!important;margin:0 0 16px!important;line-height:1.15!important}
.bf34-consent .bf34-consent-copy{background:#071d44;border:3px solid #177db4;padding:clamp(14px,2vw,22px);box-shadow:4px 4px #020e29;color:#f0f7ff}
.bf34-consent .bf34-consent-copy>p{font-family:var(--bf-font-body);font-size:clamp(13px,1.12vw,16px)!important;line-height:1.48!important;margin:0 0 12px!important}
.bf34-privacy-points{display:grid;gap:9px}
.bf34-privacy-points p{background:#0e366f;border-left:4px solid #2ed9ff;padding:10px 12px;margin:0!important;display:flex;align-items:start;gap:10px;font-size:clamp(12px,1.04vw,15px)!important;color:#f0f7ff!important;line-height:1.38!important}
.bf34-privacy-points strong{display:inline;color:#ffe379!important}
.bf34-privacy-points .bfpx-icon{margin-top:2px}
.bf34-consent .bf34-consent-check{background:#0e3976!important;border:2px solid #21b9e6!important;color:#fff!important;padding:13px!important;display:flex!important;align-items:center!important;gap:13px!important;margin-top:17px!important;font-family:var(--bf-font-body)!important;font-size:clamp(12px,1vw,14px)!important;line-height:1.38!important}
.bf34-consent-check input{accent-color:#ffc82e;transform:scale(1.25);flex:none}
.bf34-actions{margin-top:17px!important;display:flex!important;justify-content:end!important;gap:12px!important}
.bf34-actions .onboarding-btn{min-height:48px!important;padding:11px 17px!important;font-size:clamp(12px,1vw,16px)!important;font-weight:900!important;letter-spacing:.015em!important}
/* Perfil ficticio como ficha de personaje, no alta de una cuenta. */
.identity-dialog{width:min(635px,100%)!important;padding:clamp(16px,2.4dvh,27px)!important;background:#0b2b63!important}
.identity-dialog h2{font-family:var(--bf-font-display)!important;color:#ffe17b!important;font-size:clamp(22px,2.6vw,30px)!important}
.identity-dialog .identity-subtitle{font-size:clamp(13px,1vw,15px)!important;line-height:1.45!important;color:#e8f4ff!important}
.identity-dialog .identity-avatar-stage{background:#071b41!important;padding:9px!important;border:2px solid #1b90c7!important;margin:9px auto!important;max-width:225px!important}
.identity-dialog .avatar-bubble{border:3px solid #33cbff!important;box-shadow:4px 4px #020b29!important;overflow:hidden!important;background:#143e7d!important;width:min(180px,25dvh)!important;height:min(180px,25dvh)!important;margin:auto!important}
.identity-dialog .avatar-bubble img{image-rendering:pixelated!important;object-fit:contain!important;max-width:100%!important;max-height:100%!important}
.identity-dialog .identity-label{font-family:var(--bf-font-display)!important;color:#ffe17b!important;font-weight:900!important}
.identity-dialog .identity-id-row{justify-content:center!important;background:#0d3672!important;border:2px solid #177db4!important;padding:7px!important;gap:12px!important}
.identity-dialog .identity-display{font-size:clamp(16px,2.4vw,26px)!important}
.identity-dialog .identity-regenerate{border:2px solid #26cafa!important;background:#0c4c91!important;cursor:pointer}
.identity-dialog .identity-confirm-row .button-confirm{border-radius:0!important;min-height:49px!important;background:#ffd25b!important;color:#071c3d!important;border:3px solid #fff2af!important;box-shadow:4px 4px #010e2d!important;font-family:var(--bf-font-display)!important}
/* Inicio de diagnóstico + bienvenida a la ciudad con dos columnas de videojuego. */
.bf34-setup-scene,.bf34-welcome-scene{background-color:#061a49!important;background-image:repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,transparent 0 36px,#0b285b 36px 40px),linear-gradient(180deg,#071d47,#112e64)!important}
.bf34-setup-card{display:grid!important;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.15fr) minmax(210px,.85fr)!important;align-items:center!important;gap:clamp(15px,3vw,38px)!important;width:min(1020px,95vw)!important;max-height:min(90dvh,770px)!important;min-height:360px!important;padding:clamp(18px,3.4vw,38px)!important;background:#0b2b63!important;border:4px solid #27cfff!important;box-shadow:7px 7px #010b22!important;text-align:left!important;overflow:auto!important}
.bf34-setup-card .bf34-setup-copy{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:start;gap:clamp(11px,1.5vw,18px)}
.bf34-setup-card .welcome-eyebrow{color:#ffe077!important;font-family:var(--bf-font-display)!important;letter-spacing:.02em!important;font-size:clamp(12px,1.2vw,17px)!important;margin:0!important}
.bf34-setup-card h1{font-family:var(--bf-font-display)!important;font-size:clamp(22px,2.65vw,38px)!important;line-height:1.18!important;color:#31d7ff!important;text-shadow:3px 3px 0 #020d2d!important;letter-spacing:0!important}
.bf34-setup-card .welcome-story,.bf34-setup-card .intro-instruction{font-family:var(--bf-font-body)!important;color:#e9f4ff!important;font-size:clamp(13px,1.3vw,18px)!important;line-height:1.45!important;margin:0!important;max-width:600px}
.bf34-setup-card .welcome-story strong{color:#ffdf6e!important}
.bf34-setup-card .welcome-button{font-family:var(--bf-font-display)!important;font-size:clamp(12px,1.2vw,16px)!important;font-weight:900!important;background:#ffd15c!important;color:#0b2249!important;border:3px solid #fff0b0!important;box-shadow:5px 5px #04112e!important;border-radius:0!important;padding:15px 19px!important;margin:5px 0 0!important;min-height:52px!important}
.bf34-setup-card .welcome-button:hover{filter:brightness(1.08);transform:translate(-1px,-1px)!important}
.bf34-setup-art,.bf34-welcome-art{width:100%;min-height:310px;background:url('data:image/png;base64,
